Three continuous tracks: `LowerPivot:scale`, `UpperPivot:position`, `UpperPivot:scale`. Resource `godot/animations/land.tres` (brief lines 12, 41–49, 64, 69–71).

14	- **The player's state machine is `godot/features/player/player.gd`:**
15	  - `choose_pose()` (lines 147–163): override → airborne ANTIC/RISE/FALL → LAND while `land_ticks > 0` → SCOOT-A/B when `absf(velocity.x) > 8.0` → WORRY → BORED → IDLE.
16	  - `_update_pose()` (lines 165–171) sets `sprite.texture` and `sprite.flip_h`, and swaps the box: LOW 52 × 44 for LAND and BORED, else STANDING 52 × 58 (lines 11–13).
17	  - The original sprite is built in code in `_ready()` (lines 53–61): textures `CHAR-<POSE>.png`, `centered = false`, `offset = -T.JELLY_ANCHOR` (512, 812), scale `T.JELLY_SCALE` 0.106 (`godot/game/slice_tuning.gd` lines 14–15), `TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS`. The player has no `.tscn`.
18	  - Landing: `just_landed` is cleared at line 95 and set with `land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS` (8; slice_tuning line 57) at lines 136–138; it counts down at lines 140–141. `tick` advances only while `enabled` (lines 97–100).
19	  - Scoot phase: `(tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2` (line 158). `SCOOT_FRAME` is 0.12 s (slice_tuning line 58) and `ticks()` is `int(round(s * 60))` (lines 116–117): 7 ticks per cell, 14 per cycle.
20	  - Jump: buffer and coyote are 6 ticks (`godot/features/player/tuning.gd` lines 11–12). Eligibility (player.gd line 124) is checked before `move_and_slide()` and floor detection (lines 134–137).
21	  - The session writes `worried` and `override_pose` (SPLAT/RESPAWN/CELEBRATE) (`godot/game/session.gd` lines 391–392), and also `enabled`, `velocity`, `position` and `reset_at()` (lines 209, 239–240, 248–252, 267–268, 280–282, 345, 354).
22	- **Tick order:** player uses the default physics priority 0 (player.gd sets none); session 10 (session.gd line 40); effects driver 20 (`godot/effects/effects_driver.gd` line 12).
23	- **Scenes the clips will appear in (planned):**
24	  - The game: `res://game/main.tscn` (project.godot line 14) runs `session.gd`, which builds the level in code (`_build_level()`, session.gd line 87) and the player with `Player.new()` + `add_child` (lines 48–50). `player.gd` will host `player_visuals.tscn`; the original sprite stays outside it (brief lines 73, 102).
25	  - Fixtures (planned, not built yet): `res://previews/land_preview.tscn` (LAND, starting plate, real table and room) and `res://previews/scoot_preview.tscn`. Both reuse the live visual scene (brief line 115). Existing previews in `godot/previews/` are A6 particle fixtures.
26	- **How tests load the game:** every `godot/tests/test_*.gd` extends `SceneTree` (grep, 2026-11-16). `test_slice.gd` sets up the game with `Game.new()`, `test_mode = true` and `root.add_child(game)` (lines 29–31); other suites do not all load the game that way. Existing tests drive input through `player.test_control`/`test_axis`/`test_jump_*` (player.gd lines 39–42) or real events via `Input.parse_input_event` (test_slice.gd line 126).
27	- **Input in new A7 tests:** inject input only with `Input.parse_input_event`, through the real game loop (CHANGE-BRIEF.md line 110). Never `Input.action_press`, which never reaches `_input` or `_unhandled_input` (A7 handout, Step 2), never `test_control`, and never a direct call to a transition function.
28	- **Tests that read the original sprite:** `p.textures["IDLE"]` (test_slice.gd line 75), `p.sprite.flip_h` (test_slice.gd line 100; `godot/tests/capture_poses.gd` line 64). Pose sequence `["ANTIC","RISE","FALL","LAND","IDLE"]` (test_slice.gd line 109).
29	- **The wrapper (`scripts/run-test.sh`, replaced with the A7 handout version in commit `cb0e5e9`; agents never edit it):** `scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (line 2).
30	  - It runs `godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout ${3:-120}` (line 11).
31	  - `realtime` drops `--fixed-fps` (lines 5–6). The log goes to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log` or `logs/<name>_realtime.log` (lines 6, 8, 10).
32	  - It exits 1 if the log contains `SHADER ERROR`, `SCRIPT ERROR` or `Failed loading resource` (line 13). Godot's own exit 0 alone is not a pass.
33	- **Test commands** (repository root). These are the 14 counted A7 baseline runs, all exit 0 (`evidence/a7-baseline/baseline-14.txt`); summary `print` lines are in each test file:
34	  ```sh
35	  scripts/run-test.sh test_game.gd 60              # WALKER TESTS: 25 / 0          (test_game.gd line 173)
36	  scripts/run-test.sh test_slice.gd 60             # SLICE TESTS: 61 / 0           (test_slice.gd line 60)
37	  scripts/run-test.sh test_keyboard.gd 60          # KEYBOARD TESTS: 12 / 0        (test_keyboard.gd line 99)
38	  scripts/run-test.sh test_a3_assets.gd 60         # A3 ASSET CHECKS: 36 / 0       (test_a3_assets.gd line 125)
39	  scripts/run-test.sh test_fork_warning.gd 30      # FORK WARNING TESTS: 29 / 0; also 60 and 144 (line 167)
40	  scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 30         # MATERIAL CHECKS: 108 / 0; also 60 and 144 (line 456)
41	  scripts/run-test.sh test_land_puff_config.gd 60  # LAND PUFF CONFIG: 51 / 0      (line 167)
42	  scripts/run-test.sh test_land_puff_state.gd 60   # LAND PUFF STATE TESTS: 24 / 0 (line 288)
43	  scripts/run-test.sh test_dome_glints_config.gd 60 # DOME GLINTS CONFIG: 45 / 0   (line 170)
44	  scripts/run-test.sh test_dome_glints_state.gd 60 # DOME GLINTS STATE TESTS: 27 / 0 (line 257)
45	  scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300       # supplemental, not counted (README.md line 269)
46	  scripts/run-test.sh check_lifecycle_peak.gd 60   # supplemental, not counted (README.md line 270)
47	  scripts/run-test.sh <test>.gd realtime 300       # real clock, no --fixed-fps; 3rd arg = timeout s
48	  ```
49	  The brief names no A7 test files. Its state and timing checks run at 30, 60 and 144 render fps (brief line 110).
50	- **Headless facts:** `--fixed-fps N` gives N frames per game second with physics at 60 ticks/s (`logs/probe_headless_{30,60,144}fps.log`, 2026-10-27, as recorded in the A6 CLAUDE.md). Some suites print `ObjectDB instances were leaked` and `resources still in use` at exit (8 of the 14 A7 baseline logs; `TEST-REPORT.md`, "A7 baseline"); these lines match none of the wrapper's error patterns.
51	  - Frame strips come from a windowed Movie Maker run, which Kiran starts (confirmed 2026-11-16 with `landing-r0`, a windowed `--write-movie` run at 60 fps).
52	
53	## Current change
54	
55	@CHANGE-BRIEF.md
56	
57	## Ownership
58	
59	- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). No agent creates, edits, reformats or "fixes" any file there. If a shader has an error, report the error text and the line, and stop.
60	- Clips live as saved resources in `godot/animations/` (`scoot.tres`, `land.tres`) or in the scene that owns them (`player_visuals.tscn`). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.
61	- Static rig and sprite settings (texture, `hframes`, `region_rect`, `offset`, scale, filter, rest positions) live in `player_visuals.tscn`, not in code.
62	- `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png` is produced only by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`, which Kiran reviews and runs (brief line 25). Source PNGs never change (AGENTS.md).
63	- A6 effect settings stay in `godot/effects/*.tscn`. `effects_driver.gd` stays as it is.
64	
65	## One authority
66	
67	Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).
68	
69	| Node and property | The only writer |
70	| --- | --- |
71	| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
72	| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
73	| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
74	| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
75	| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. The supplemental timing probe `godot/tests/probe_a7_entry_order.gd` plays only its own instance of `player_visuals.tscn`, never the game's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 1) |
76	| Original pose sprite: `texture`, `flip_h`, visibility | `player.gd` |
77	| Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
78	| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |
79	
80	The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).
81	
82	## Godot 4 names
83	
84	- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.
85	- Loop: `Animation.loop_mode` with `Animation.LOOP_NONE` / `LOOP_LINEAR`, never a boolean `loop`. Speed: `speed_scale`, never `playback_speed`. Callback: `callback_mode_process` with `AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS`, never `playback_process_mode`.
86	- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).
87	- Checked against the Godot 4.7 class reference, but not yet probed on the installed 4.7.2 build: no ClassDB probe was run for A7 (see Unconfirmed). If unsure a property, constant or method exists in 4.7.2, say so and check the 4.7 class reference or ClassDB before using it.
88	
89	## Out of scope
90	
91	- Gameplay: movement, input, jump buffer and coyote, collision boxes and layers, `choose_pose()` (its order, conditions and return values), `LAND_TICKS`, `SCOOT_FRAME` and every other value in `slice_tuning.gd` and `tuning.gd`.
92	- In `player.gd`, everything except the visual setup and the pose-to-visual mapping (brief line 102). `session.gd`, `fork.gd`, the HUD, sound and music, other level objects.
93	- The A5 shaders and materials, the A6 effects and driver, all source art and `.import` files other than the new sheet's, every existing test and its expected counts, and `scripts/run-test.sh`.
94	- Anything the brief does not name: no extra clips, AnimationTree, blend or state machine, bones or Skeleton2D, rotation, lag, overshoot, new gameplay windows, or keys on gameplay values.
95	
96	## Unconfirmed
97	
98	- **Animation API names on the installed 4.7.2 build:** checked against the 4.7 class reference, not yet probed with ClassDB. Includes `loop_mode`, `step`, `value_track_set_update_mode`, the key `transition` argument, `seek()`'s `update` argument, `current_animation_position` and `callback_mode_process`.
99	- **Same-tick ordering:** whether the AnimationPlayer's physics-callback update runs before or after `player.gd`'s `_physics_process` in one tick. Also whether a `play()` + `seek()` from player.gd shows the synced frame on that tick or the next. This decides the "no extra advance on entry" check (brief line 100).
100	- **`landing-r0`:** Kiran's windowed 60 fps Movie Maker capture of the existing game. The full capture stays outside the repository (`~/Documents/a7-reference/landing-r0/`). The frame reading (last FALL 291, LAND 292–299, upright 300) is Kiran's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Landing reference and phase table"). Any selected frames committed later are labelled as the existing gameplay reference, not as fixtures. The physics timing behind the reading stays unconfirmed until the pins run.
101	- **Behaviour pins:** none exist yet. The brief requires them committed before wiring (line 111).
102	- **Hosting:** how `player.gd` attaches `player_visuals.tscn`, and how the original sprite is hidden, is not specified. It needs a plan Kiran approves.
103	- **Saved library format:** whether an embedded AnimationLibrary that references external `.tres` clips saves and reloads as intended, including from an empty import cache.
104	- **Headless facts pending confirmation:** that a headless run advances clips and reads their structure but draws nothing; that saved key times are 32-bit floats, so they are compared with a tolerance; and that `value_track_get_update_mode` applies only to value tracks (this rig has only 2D value tracks, so the non-value case cannot arise here). Each moves to Headless facts once confirmed on this machine.
105	- **Realtime runs:** `baseline-14.txt` lists fixed-fps runs only. No realtime run of the suites is recorded for A7.
106	- **Check runners:** README.md line 33 names `tools/run_slice_checks.sh`; AGENTS.md requires `scripts/run-test.sh`. I did not read `run_slice_checks.sh`.
107	- **A6 open items:** GPU timing, puff overlap, gameplay peak and others are listed in the A6 version of this file in git history. None was rechecked for A7.

## Ownership

- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). No agent creates, edits, reformats or "fixes" any file there. If a shader has an error, report the error text and the line, and stop.
- Clips live as saved resources in `godot/animations/` (`scoot.tres`, `land.tres`) or in the scene that owns them (`player_visuals.tscn`). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.
- Static rig and sprite settings (texture, `hframes`, `region_rect`, `offset`, scale, filter, rest positions) live in `player_visuals.tscn`, not in code.
- `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png` is produced only by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`, which Kiran reviews and runs (brief line 25). Source PNGs never change (AGENTS.md).
- A6 effect settings stay in `godot/effects/*.tscn`. `effects_driver.gd` stays as it is.

## One authority

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

| Node and property | The only writer |
| --- | --- |
| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. The supplemental timing probe `godot/tests/probe_a7_entry_order.gd` plays only its own instance of `player_visuals.tscn`, never the game's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 1) |
| Original pose sprite: `texture`, `flip_h`, visibility | `player.gd` |
| Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |

The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).

## Godot 4 names

- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.
- Loop: `Animation.loop_mode` with `Animation.LOOP_NONE` / `LOOP_LINEAR`, never a boolean `loop`. Speed: `speed_scale`, never `playback_speed`. Callback: `callback_mode_process` with `AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS`, never `playback_process_mode`.
- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).
- Checked against the Godot 4.7 class reference, but not yet probed on the installed 4.7.2 build: no ClassDB probe was run for A7 (see Unconfirmed). If unsure a property, constant or method exists in 4.7.2, say so and check the 4.7 class reference or ClassDB before using it.

## Out of scope

- Gameplay: movement, input, jump buffer and coyote, collision boxes and layers, `choose_pose()` (its order, conditions and return values), `LAND_TICKS`, `SCOOT_FRAME` and every other value in `slice_tuning.gd` and `tuning.gd`.
- In `player.gd`, everything except the visual setup and the pose-to-visual mapping (brief line 102). `session.gd`, `fork.gd`, the HUD, sound and music, other level objects.
- The A5 shaders and materials, the A6 effects and driver, all source art and `.import` files other than the new sheet's, every existing test and its expected counts, and `scripts/run-test.sh`.
- Anything the brief does not name: no extra clips, AnimationTree, blend or state machine, bones or Skeleton2D, rotation, lag, overshoot, new gameplay windows, or keys on gameplay values.

## Unconfirmed

- **Animation API names on the installed 4.7.2 build:** checked against the 4.7 class reference, not yet probed with ClassDB. Includes `loop_mode`, `step`, `value_track_set_update_mode`, the key `transition` argument, `seek()`'s `update` argument, `current_animation_position` and `callback_mode_process`.
- **Same-tick ordering:** whether the AnimationPlayer's physics-callback update runs before or after `player.gd`'s `_physics_process` in one tick. Also whether a `play()` + `seek()` from player.gd shows the synced frame on that tick or the next. This decides the "no extra advance on entry" check (brief line 100).
- **`landing-r0`:** Kiran's windowed 60 fps Movie Maker capture of the existing game. The full capture stays outside the repository (`~/Documents/a7-reference/landing-r0/`). The frame reading (last FALL 291, LAND 292–299, upright 300) is Kiran's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Landing reference and phase table"). Any selected frames committed later are labelled as the existing gameplay reference, not as fixtures. The physics timing behind the reading stays unconfirmed until the pins run.
- **Behaviour pins:** none exist yet. The brief requires them committed before wiring (line 111).
- **Hosting:** how `player.gd` attaches `player_visuals.tscn`, and how the original sprite is hidden, is not specified. It needs a plan Kiran approves.
- **Saved library format:** whether an embedded AnimationLibrary that references external `.tres` clips saves and reloads as intended, including from an empty import cache.
- **Headless facts pending confirmation:** that a headless run advances clips and reads their structure but draws nothing; that saved key times are 32-bit floats, so they are compared with a tolerance; and that `value_track_get_update_mode` applies only to value tracks (this rig has only 2D value tracks, so the non-value case cannot arise here). Each moves to Headless facts once confirmed on this machine.
- **Realtime runs:** `baseline-14.txt` lists fixed-fps runs only. No realtime run of the suites is recorded for A7.
- **Check runners:** README.md line 33 names `tools/run_slice_checks.sh`; AGENTS.md requires `scripts/run-test.sh`. I did not read `run_slice_checks.sh`.
- **A6 open items:** GPU timing, puff overlap, gameplay peak and others are listed in the A6 version of this file in git history. None was rechecked for A7.

147	func choose_pose() -> String:
148		## CHARACTER-SHEET.md pose table. Worried always overrides bored.
149		if override_pose != "":
150			return override_pose
151		if not was_grounded:
152			if hop_ticks >= 0 and hop_ticks <= T.ANTIC_TICKS:
153				return "ANTIC"   # visual only: shown at takeoff, no input delay
154			return "RISE" if velocity.y < 0.0 else "FALL"
155		if land_ticks > 0:
156			return "LAND"
157		if absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
158			return "SCOOT-A" if (tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2 == 0 else "SCOOT-B"
159		if worried:
160			return "WORRY"
161		if idle_ticks >= T.ticks(T.BORED_DELAY):
162			return "BORED"
163		return "IDLE"

165	func _update_pose() -> void:
166		pose = choose_pose()
167		sprite.texture = textures[pose]
168		sprite.flip_h = facing < 0.0   # drawn facing right; keeps the last direction moved
169		var wanted := LOW if pose in LOW_POSES else STANDING
170		if wanted != box:
171			set_box(wanted)
172		_update_visuals()
173	
174	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- A7 visual layer
175	## CHANGE-BRIEF.md (A7), "Scene, authority and states" and Revision 1. Everything below only reads
176	## gameplay state (pose, facing, tick, land_ticks, just_landed, enabled); it never writes it.
177	## The AnimationPlayer alone writes ScootSprite.frame and the rig pivots; this code writes only the
178	## facing mirror, the three visibility flags and the playback calls.
179	
180	const VISUALS_SCENE = preload("res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn")
181	## Pose -> clip. Every other pose shows the original sprite with no clip.
182	const POSE_CLIPS := {"LAND": &"land", "SCOOT-A": &"scoot", "SCOOT-B": &"scoot"}
183	const CLIP_FPS := 60.0   # both clips: step 1/60 s, one physics tick per timeline frame
184	
185	var visuals: Node2D
186	var facing_pivot: Node2D
187	var scoot_node: Node2D
188	var land_rig: Node2D
189	var anim: AnimationPlayer
190	var clip: StringName = &""        # the clip this code last entered, or "" for the original sprite
191	var clip_held: bool = false       # the player was disabled with a clip selected: re-enter when enabled
192	
193	func _update_visuals() -> void:
194		if visuals == null:
195			visuals = VISUALS_SCENE.instantiate()
196			add_child(visuals)
197			facing_pivot = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot")
198			scoot_node = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/Scoot")
199			land_rig = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/LandRig")
200			anim = visuals.get_node("AnimationPlayer")
201		facing_pivot.transform = Transform2D(Vector2(facing, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)
202		var want: StringName = POSE_CLIPS.get(pose, &"")
203		scoot_node.visible = want == &"scoot"
204		land_rig.visible = want == &"land"
205		sprite.visible = want == &""
206		if want == &"":
207			# Leaving a clip (hop, walk-off, override, tick-8 hand-off, reset): stop it.
208			if clip != &"":
209				anim.stop()
210			clip = &""
211			clip_held = false
212			return
213		if not enabled:
214			# Paused or locked with a clip selected: freeze it; it re-enters on the first enabled tick.
215			if clip != want and clip != &"":
216				anim.stop()
217			clip = want
218			if anim.is_playing():
219				anim.pause()
220			clip_held = true
221			return
222		var entry := want != clip or clip_held or (want == &"land" and just_landed)
223		if not entry:
224			return   # steady tick, including SCOOT-A <-> SCOOT-B: no call
225		if clip != &"" and clip != want:
226			anim.stop()
227		anim.play(want)
228		if clip == &"land" and want == &"scoot" and not clip_held:
229			# Direct LAND -> SCOOT switch: the AnimationPlayer was already playing land, and its own update
230			# later this tick adds 1/60 (fd4d855). Seek one tick earlier on the loop so it lands on the synced time
231			# (probe H3, prompt-5e).
232			anim.seek(fposmod(_clip_time(want) - 1.0 / CLIP_FPS, anim.get_animation(&"scoot").length), true)
233		else:
234			anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)
235		clip = want
236		clip_held = false
237	
238	func _clip_time(c: StringName) -> float:
239		## The synced entry time: LAND (8 - land_ticks) / 60, SCOOT (tick % 14) / 60.
240		if c == &"land":
241			return float(T.LAND_TICKS - land_ticks) / CLIP_FPS
242		return float(tick % (2 * T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME))) / CLIP_FPS

	sprite.scale = Vector2.ONE * T.JELLY_SCALE
	sprite.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS

func set_box(size: Vector2) -> void:
	box = size
	(collider.shape as RectangleShape2D).size = size
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -size.y / 2.0)

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jumps = 0
	was_grounded = true   # placing the jelly on a plate is not a landing
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	idle_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	hop_ticks = -1
	require_fresh_press()
	_update_pose()

func require_fresh_press() -> void:
	## The next hop needs a new jump press: a held key must be released first, and a press
	## that arrived with the key that changed the state (skip, restart, unpause) is ignored.
	## A held direction is ignored the same way, so the skip or restart key never moves the jelly.
	require_jump_release = true
	require_axis_release = true
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	test_jump_pressed = false
	ignore_press_through_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames() + 1

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	if not enabled:
		_update_pose()
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	if is_zero_approx(axis):
		require_axis_release = false
	elif require_axis_release:
		axis = 0.0
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if pressed and Engine.get_physics_frames() <= ignore_press_through_frame:
		pressed = false
	idle_ticks = 0 if (not is_zero_approx(axis) or held or pressed) else idle_ticks + 1
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		just_hopped = true
		hop_ticks = 0
		# Grounded (or coyote) -> airborne after a fresh jump press: the only place SFX-HOP plays.
		if sound:
			sound.play("SFX-HOP")
	move_and_slide()
	var grounded := is_on_floor()
	if grounded and not was_grounded:
		just_landed = true
		land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS
		hop_ticks = -1

## A7 Step 5, plan step 1: supplemental timing probe (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Revision 1, "Evidence split").
## Not counted. Never loads or instantiates the game. Each run instantiates its own copy of
## player_visuals.tscn under a stand-in parent (Node2D, physics priority 0, the way Player will sit above
## PlayerVisuals) and a late hook (Node, physics priority 1000, the pattern of TickHook in test_a7_pins.gd).
## The stand-in's _physics_process makes the scheduled AnimationPlayer calls (play / seek / pause), where
## player.gd will make them; nothing else in this probe calls playback. No clip is built, keyed or
## modified: the probe only reads clip values (value_track_interpolate) for the expected rig values.
## Headless: positions and node properties are read; nothing is drawn. Scripted calls, not a playtest.
## Engine behaviour that differs from the plan's assumptions is a finding (printed), not a failure.
## Exit 1 only if the probe itself cannot run (missing scene, node, clip or track; a tick not logged).
##
## Per tick: EARLY = current_animation_position read in the stand-in before any call that tick;
## MID = read right after the call (call ticks only); LATE = read in the late hook, after the stand-in
## and the AnimationPlayer have both updated that tick.

const SCENE_PATH := "res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn"
const LOWER_SCALE_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot:scale"
const UPPER_POS_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:position"
const UPPER_SCALE_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:scale"
const F := 1.0 / 60.0
const PRE := 3            # stand-in ticks before entry (n = 0 is the entry tick)
## Hand-off runs (prompt-5d): land is entered at n = LAND_ENTRY_N with play + seek(0, true), the way
## player.gd enters it on touchdown, so at n = -1 it shows 7/60 (land_ticks = 1), the tick before the
## game's tick-8 LAND -> SCOOT hand-off. On n = 0 the stand-in switches to scoot at k/60 with H0, H1 or H2.
const HANDOFF_PRE := 10   # stand-in ticks before the hand-off tick in hand-off runs
const LAND_ENTRY_N := -8
const PAUSE_LEN := 10     # paused ticks: n = p .. p + PAUSE_LEN - 1; resume on n = p + PAUSE_LEN
const SCOOT_TICKS := 32   # SCOOT ticks logged from entry (and again from a resume): more than two cycles
const POST := 2           # LAND ticks logged after the expected time reaches 8/60 (informational)
const TOL_T := 1e-6
const TOL_V := 1e-4

class StandIn extends Node2D:
	## Stands in for Player (priority 0, parent of PlayerVisuals).
	var s := 0
	var on_tick: Callable
	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
		on_tick.call(s)
		s += 1

## One authority

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

| --- | --- |
| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. | Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |

The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).

- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.

- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).

- Gameplay: movement, input, jump buffer and coyote, collision boxes and layers, `choose_pose()` (its order, conditions and return values), `LAND_TICKS`, `SCOOT_FRAME` and every other value in `slice_tuning.gd` and `tuning.gd`.

## Ownership

- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.

## One authority

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

| Node and property | The only writer |
| --- | --- |
| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. The supplemental timing probe `godot/tests/probe_a7_entry_order.gd` plays only its own instance of `player_visuals.tscn`, never the game's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 1) |
| Original pose sprite: `texture`, `flip_h`, visibility | `player.gd` |
| Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |

The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).

## Godot 4 names

- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.
- Loop: `Animation.loop_mode` with `Animation.LOOP_NONE` / `LOOP_LINEAR`, never a boolean `loop`. Speed: `speed_scale`, never `playback_speed`. Callback: `callback_mode_process` with `AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS`, never `playback_process_mode`.
- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).
- Checked against the Godot 4.7 class reference, but not yet probed on the installed 4.7.2 build: no ClassDB probe was run for A7 (see Unconfirmed). If unsure a property, constant or method exists in 4.7.2, say so and check the 4.7 class reference or ClassDB before using it.

## Out of scope

- Gameplay: movement, input, jump buffer and coyote, collision boxes and layers, `choose_pose()` (its order, conditions and return values), `LAND_TICKS`, `SCOOT_FRAME` and every other value in `slice_tuning.gd` and `tuning.gd`.
- In `player.gd`, everything except the visual setup and the pose-to-visual mapping (brief line 102). `session.gd`, `fork.gd`, the HUD, sound and music, other level objects.
- The A5 shaders and materials, the A6 effects and driver, all source art and `.import` files other than the new sheet's, every existing test and its expected counts, and `scripts/run-test.sh`.
- Anything the brief does not name: no extra clips, AnimationTree, blend or state machine, bones or Skeleton2D, rotation, lag, overshoot, new gameplay windows, or keys on gameplay values.

@AGENTS.md

# CLAUDE.md — Assignment 7 (animation)

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf (README.md line 13; CHANGE-BRIEF.md line 5; `evidence/a7-baseline/import.txt` line 1). `godot/project.godot` line 15: `config/features=PackedStringArray("4.7", "GL Compatibility")`.
- **Renderer:** Compatibility: `renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"` and `.mobile` the same (`godot/project.godot` lines 32–33). Viewport 1280 × 720, stretch `canvas_items` (lines 19–21).
- **Clip `scoot`** (looping): Sprite2D cell route. `FacingPivot/Scoot/ScootSprite` (Sprite2D, `hframes = 2`, `vframes = 1`) shows `godot/assets/art/CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png`, packed from CHAR-SCOOT-A/B by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`. One discrete track on `:frame`. Resource `godot/animations/scoot.tres` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md lines 11, 25, 27, 45, 64, 68; `player_visuals.tscn` lines 20–29).
- **Clip `land`** (one-shot): native cutout rig. Two Sprite2D slices of `CHAR-IDLE.png`: `FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot/LowerSprite` and `FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot/UpperSprite`. Three continuous tracks: `LowerPivot:scale`, `UpperPivot:position`, `UpperPivot:scale`. Resource `godot/animations/land.tres`; r1 keys (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Revision 3, `9ada865`) (brief lines 12, 41–49, 64, 69–71; `player_visuals.tscn` lines 31–59).
- **Both clips play on one `AnimationPlayer`**, a sibling of `FacingPivot` in `godot/features/player/player_visuals.tscn` (root `PlayerVisuals`, Node2D), with `root_node = NodePath("..")`, one embedded AnimationLibrary referencing both `.tres` files, `callback_mode_process = 0` (PHYSICS) and empty autoplay (`player_visuals.tscn` lines 4, 6, 8–12, 61–67; brief lines 64, 98).
- **Built** (glob, 2026-11-17): `godot/animations/{scoot,land}.tres`, `player_visuals.tscn`, the sheet PNG with `.import` and `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.ATTRIBUTION.md`, `make_scoot_sheet.gd`, `godot/previews/{land,scoot}_preview.{tscn,gd}`, and the A7 tests below.
- **Sheet import settings match:** the `[params]` block of `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png.import` (lines 16–40) is line-for-line identical to `CHAR-SCOOT-A.png.import` (lines 16–40), including `compress/mode=0`, `mipmaps/generate=true`, `mipmaps/limit=-1`, `process/fix_alpha_border=true`, `process/premult_alpha=false`, `process/size_limit=0`. CHAR-SCOOT-A and -B `[params]` are identical (only `uid`, `path`, `source_file`, `dest_files` differ).
- **The player's state machine is `godot/features/player/player.gd`:**
  - `choose_pose()` (lines 147–163): override → airborne ANTIC/RISE/FALL → LAND while `land_ticks > 0` → SCOOT-A/B when `absf(velocity.x) > 8.0` → WORRY → BORED → IDLE.
  - `_update_pose()` (lines 165–171) sets `sprite.texture` and `sprite.flip_h`, and swaps the box: LOW 52 × 44 for LAND and BORED, else STANDING 52 × 58 (lines 11–13). Line 172 then calls `_update_visuals()`.
  - **Hosting:** `_update_visuals()` (lines 193–236) instantiates `player_visuals.tscn` as a child on first call (lines 194–200; preload line 180), sets the `FacingPivot` mirror (line 201), maps pose → clip via `POSE_CLIPS` (line 182) and shows exactly one of `Scoot`, `LandRig` or the original sprite (lines 203–205). Playback: stop on exit (206–212), pause while disabled (213–221), synced entry via `_clip_time()` (238–242), the Revision 2 LAND → SCOOT seek (228–232). Structure test 29/0 checks the hosting (TEST-REPORT.md line 746).
  - The original sprite is built in code in `_ready()` (lines 53–61): textures `CHAR-<POSE>.png`, `centered = false`, `offset = -T.JELLY_ANCHOR` (512, 812), scale `T.JELLY_SCALE` 0.106 (`godot/game/slice_tuning.gd` lines 14–15), `TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS`. The player has no `.tscn`.
  - Landing: `just_landed` is cleared at line 95 and set with `land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS` (8; slice_tuning line 57) at lines 136–138; it counts down at lines 140–141. `tick` advances only while `enabled` (lines 97–100).
  - Scoot phase: `(tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2` (line 158). `SCOOT_FRAME` is 0.12 s (slice_tuning line 58) and `ticks()` is `int(round(s * 60))` (lines 116–117): 7 ticks per cell, 14 per cycle.
  - Jump: buffer and coyote are 6 ticks (`godot/features/player/tuning.gd` lines 11–12). Eligibility (player.gd line 124) is checked before `move_and_slide()` and floor detection (lines 134–137).
  - The session writes `worried` and `override_pose` (SPLAT/RESPAWN/CELEBRATE) (`godot/game/session.gd` lines 391–392), and also `enabled`, `velocity`, `position` and `reset_at()` (lines 209, 239–240, 248–252, 267–268, 280–282, 345, 354).
- **Tick order:** player uses the default physics priority 0 (player.gd sets none); session 10 (session.gd line 40); effects driver 20 (`godot/effects/effects_driver.gd` line 12).
- **Same-tick order (probe A1, confirmed):** the AnimationPlayer's physics-callback update runs *after* its parent's `_physics_process` in the same tick: `A1SUM ... before_parent=0` for every route at 30, 60 and 144 (`logs/probe_a7_entry_order_{30,60,144}fps.log` lines 5486–5495). A fresh `play()` + `seek(t, true)` shows `t` on the entry tick with no extra advance (`ENTRYADV R1 ... {"0.000000":19}`, line 5496; `SELECT R1 ... meets_rule_at_this_rate=yes`, line 5512). A `play()` while already playing adds 1/60 (`fd4d855`); fixed for LAND → SCOOT by H3 (`H3VERDICT ... pass=yes`, line 5528; `5c0fb9a`; CHANGE-BRIEF.md Revision 2).
- **Scenes the clips appear in:**
  - The game: `res://game/main.tscn` (project.godot line 14) runs `session.gd`, which builds the level in code (`_build_level()`, session.gd line 87) and the player with `Player.new()` + `add_child` (lines 48–50). `player.gd` hosts `player_visuals.tscn` (Hosting, above); the original sprite stays outside it (brief lines 73, 102).
  - Fixtures: `res://previews/land_preview.tscn` (LAND, starting plate, real table and room) and `res://previews/scoot_preview.tscn`, with their `.gd` scripts. Both reuse the live visual scene (brief line 115). The other previews in `godot/previews/` are A6 particle fixtures.
- **How tests load the game:** every `godot/tests/test_*.gd` extends `SceneTree` (grep, 2026-11-16). `test_slice.gd` sets up the game with `Game.new()`, `test_mode = true` and `root.add_child(game)` (lines 29–31); other suites do not all load the game that way. Existing tests drive input through `player.test_control`/`test_axis`/`test_jump_*` (player.gd lines 39–42) or real events via `Input.parse_input_event` (test_slice.gd line 126).
- **Input in new A7 tests:** inject input only with `Input.parse_input_event`, through the real game loop (CHANGE-BRIEF.md line 110). Never `Input.action_press`, which never reaches `_input` or `_unhandled_input` (A7 handout, Step 2), never `test_control`, and never a direct call to a transition function.
- **Tests that read the original sprite:** `p.textures["IDLE"]` (test_slice.gd line 75), `p.sprite.flip_h` (test_slice.gd line 100; `godot/tests/capture_poses.gd` line 64). Pose sequence `["ANTIC","RISE","FALL","LAND","IDLE"]` (test_slice.gd line 109).
- **The wrapper (`scripts/run-test.sh`, replaced with the A7 handout version in commit `cb0e5e9`; agents never edit it):** `scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (line 2).
  - It runs `godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout ${3:-120}` (line 11).
  - `realtime` drops `--fixed-fps` (lines 5–6). The log goes to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log` or `logs/<name>_realtime.log` (lines 6, 8, 10).
  - It exits 1 if the log contains `SHADER ERROR`, `SCRIPT ERROR` or `Failed loading resource` (line 13). Godot's own exit 0 alone is not a pass.
- **Test commands** (repository root). These are the 14 counted A7 baseline runs, all exit 0 (`evidence/a7-baseline/baseline-14.txt`); summary `print` lines are in each test file:
  ```sh
  scripts/run-test.sh test_game.gd 60              # WALKER TESTS: 25 / 0          (test_game.gd line 173)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_slice.gd 60             # SLICE TESTS: 61 / 0           (test_slice.gd line 60)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_keyboard.gd 60          # KEYBOARD TESTS: 12 / 0        (test_keyboard.gd line 99)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_a3_assets.gd 60         # A3 ASSET CHECKS: 36 / 0       (test_a3_assets.gd line 125)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_fork_warning.gd 30      # FORK WARNING TESTS: 29 / 0; also 60 and 144 (line 167)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 30         # MATERIAL CHECKS: 108 / 0; also 60 and 144 (line 456)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_land_puff_config.gd 60  # LAND PUFF CONFIG: 51 / 0      (line 167)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_land_puff_state.gd 60   # LAND PUFF STATE TESTS: 24 / 0 (line 288)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_dome_glints_config.gd 60 # DOME GLINTS CONFIG: 45 / 0   (line 170)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_dome_glints_state.gd 60 # DOME GLINTS STATE TESTS: 27 / 0 (line 257)
  scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300       # supplemental, not counted (README.md line 269)
  scripts/run-test.sh check_lifecycle_peak.gd 60   # supplemental, not counted (README.md line 270)
  scripts/run-test.sh <test>.gd realtime 300       # real clock, no --fixed-fps; 3rd arg = timeout s
  ```
  The brief names no A7 test files. Its state and timing checks run at 30, 60 and 144 render fps (brief line 110).
- **Headless facts:** `--fixed-fps N` gives N frames per game second with physics at 60 ticks/s (`logs/probe_headless_{30,60,144}fps.log`, 2026-10-27, as recorded in the A6 CLAUDE.md). Some suites print `ObjectDB instances were leaked` and `resources still in use` at exit (8 of the 14 A7 baseline logs; `TEST-REPORT.md`, "A7 baseline"); these lines match none of the wrapper's error patterns.
  - Frame strips come from a windowed Movie Maker run, which Kiran starts (confirmed 2026-11-16 with `landing-r0`, a windowed `--write-movie` run at 60 fps).

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). No agent creates, edits, reformats or "fixes" any file there. If a shader has an error, report the error text and the line, and stop.
- Clips live as saved resources in `godot/animations/` (`scoot.tres`, `land.tres`) or in the scene that owns them (`player_visuals.tscn`). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.
- Static rig and sprite settings (texture, `hframes`, `region_rect`, `offset`, scale, filter, rest positions) live in `player_visuals.tscn`, not in code.
- `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png` is produced only by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`, which Kiran reviews and runs (brief line 25). Source PNGs never change (AGENTS.md).
- A6 effect settings stay in `godot/effects/*.tscn`. `effects_driver.gd` stays as it is.

## One authority

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

| Node and property | The only writer |
| --- | --- |
| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. The supplemental timing probe `godot/tests/probe_a7_entry_order.gd` plays only its own instance of `player_visuals.tscn`, never the game's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 1) |
| Original pose sprite: `texture`, `flip_h`, visibility | `player.gd` |
| Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |

The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).

## Godot 4 names

- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.
- Loop: `Animation.loop_mode` with `Animation.LOOP_NONE` / `LOOP_LINEAR`, never a boolean `loop`. Speed: `speed_scale`, never `playback_speed`. Callback: `callback_mode_process` with `AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS`, never `playback_process_mode`.
- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).
- Checked against the Godot 4.7 class reference, but not yet probed on the installed 4.7.2 build: no ClassDB probe was run for A7 (see Unconfirmed). If unsure a property, constant or method exists in 4.7.2, say so and check the 4.7 class reference or ClassDB before using it.

## Out of scope

- Gameplay: movement, input, jump buffer and coyote, collision boxes and layers, `choose_pose()` (its order, conditions and return values), `LAND_TICKS`, `SCOOT_FRAME` and every other value in `slice_tuning.gd` and `tuning.gd`.
- In `player.gd`, everything except the visual setup and the pose-to-visual mapping (brief line 102). `session.gd`, `fork.gd`, the HUD, sound and music, other level objects.
- The A5 shaders and materials, the A6 effects and driver, all source art and `.import` files other than the new sheet's, every existing test and its expected counts, and `scripts/run-test.sh`.
- Anything the brief does not name: no extra clips, AnimationTree, blend or state machine, bones or Skeleton2D, rotation, lag, overshoot, new gameplay windows, or keys on gameplay values.

## Unconfirmed

- **Animation API names on the installed 4.7.2 build:** checked against the 4.7 class reference, not yet probed with ClassDB. Includes `loop_mode`, `step`, `value_track_set_update_mode`, the key `transition` argument, `seek()`'s `update` argument, `current_animation_position` and `callback_mode_process`.
- **Same-tick ordering:** whether the AnimationPlayer's physics-callback update runs before or after `player.gd`'s `_physics_process` in one tick. ## Ownership

- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). No agent creates, edits, reformats or "fixes" any file there. If a shader has an error, report the error text and the line, and stop.
- Clips live as saved resources in `godot/animations/` (`scoot.tres`, `land.tres`) or in the scene that owns them (`player_visuals.tscn`). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.
- Static rig and sprite settings (texture, `hframes`, `region_rect`, `offset`, scale, filter, rest positions) live in `player_visuals.tscn`, not in code.
- `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png` is produced only by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`, which Kiran reviews and runs (brief line 25). Source PNGs never change (AGENTS.md).
- A6 effect settings stay in `godot/effects/*.tscn`. `effects_driver.gd` stays as it is.

## One authority

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

| Node and property | The only writer |
| --- | --- |
| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. The supplemental timing probe `godot/tests/probe_a7_entry_order.gd` plays only its own instance of `player_visuals.tscn`, never the game's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 1) |
| Original pose sprite: `texture`, `flip_h`, visibility | `player.gd` |
| Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |

The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).

## Godot 4 names

- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.
- Loop: `Animation.loop_mode` with `Animation.LOOP_NONE` / `LOOP_LINEAR`, never a boolean `loop`. Speed: `speed_scale`, never `playback_speed`. Callback: `callback_mode_process` with `AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS`, never `playback_process_mode`.
- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).

## Ownership

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

CHAR-SCOOT-A and -B `[params]` are identical (only `uid`, `path`, `source_file`, `dest_files` differ).
- **The player's state machine is `godot/features/player/player.gd`:**
  - `choose_pose()` (lines 147–163): override → airborne ANTIC/RISE/FALL → LAND while `land_ticks > 0` → SCOOT-A/B when `absf(velocity.x) > 8.0` → WORRY → BORED → IDLE.
  - `_update_pose()` (lines 165–171) sets `sprite.texture` and `sprite.flip_h`, and swaps the box: LOW 52 × 44 for LAND and BORED, else STANDING 52 × 58 (lines 11–13). Line 172 then calls `_update_visuals()`.
  - **Hosting:** `_update_visuals()` (lines 193–236) instantiates `player_visuals.tscn` as a child on first call (lines 194–200; preload line 180), sets the `FacingPivot` mirror (line 201), maps pose → clip via `POSE_CLIPS` (line 182) and shows exactly one of `Scoot`, `LandRig` or the original sprite (lines 203–205). Playback: stop on exit (206–212), pause while disabled (213–221), synced entry via `_clip_time()` (238–242), the Revision 2 LAND → SCOOT seek (228–232). Structure test 29/0 checks the hosting (TEST-REPORT.md line 746).
  - The original sprite is built in code in `_ready()` (lines 53–61): textures `CHAR-<POSE>.png`, `centered = false`, `offset = -T.JELLY_ANCHOR` (512, 812), scale `T.JELLY_SCALE` 0.106 (`godot/game/slice_tuning.gd` lines 14–15), `TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS`. The player has no `.tscn`.

Existing tests drive input through `player.test_control`/`test_axis`/`test_jump_*` (player.gd lines 39–42) or real events via `Input.parse_input_event` (test_slice.gd line 126).

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). No agent creates, edits, reformats or "fixes" any file there. If a shader has an error, report the error text and the line, and stop.
- Clips live as saved resources in `godot/animations/` (`scoot.tres`, `land.tres`) or in the scene that owns them (`player_visuals.tscn`). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.
- Static rig and sprite settings (texture, `hframes`, `region_rect`, `offset`, scale, filter, rest positions) live in `player_visuals.tscn`, not in code.
- `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png` is produced only by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`, which Kiran reviews and runs (brief line 25). Source PNGs never change (AGENTS.md).

## Ownership

- Every file in `godot/shaders/` is hand-written by Kiran, except `standard_generated.gdshader` and `particles_generated.gdshader` (both generated by Godot, saved by Kiran exactly as generated; `particles_generated.gdshader` is a copy of LandPuff's process material converted for A6 Step 6 and is not used by the game). No agent creates, edits, reformats or "fixes" any file there. If a shader has an error, report the error text and the line, and stop.
- Clips live as saved resources in `godot/animations/` (`scoot.tres`, `land.tres`) or in the scene that owns them (`player_visuals.tscn`). Keys, tracks, length, step and loop mode are authored in those files. They are never built, keyed or modified in code at runtime: no `Animation.new()`, `track_insert_key()` or `add_animation_library()` in game or preview scripts. Read-only checks may load and inspect them.
- Static rig and sprite settings (texture, `hframes`, `region_rect`, `offset`, scale, filter, rest positions) live in `player_visuals.tscn`, not in code.
- `CHAR-SCOOT-SHEET.png` is produced only by `godot/tools/make_scoot_sheet.gd`, which Kiran reviews and runs (brief line 25). Source PNGs never change (AGENTS.md).
- A6 effect settings stay in `godot/effects/*.tscn`. `effects_driver.gd` stays as it is.

## One authority

Exactly one writer per animated node and property. Never add a second writer to a node that already has one: no script assignment, Tween, second AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, method track or `RESET` clip on these targets (brief lines 49–51, 73, 83, 141).

| Node and property | The only writer |
| --- | --- |
| `ScootSprite.frame` | The AnimationPlayer (`scoot`) |
| `LowerPivot.scale`, `UpperPivot.position`, `UpperPivot.scale` | The AnimationPlayer (`land`) |
| `FacingPivot.transform` (mirror ±1 on X) | `player.gd` |
| `Scoot.visible`, `LandRig.visible` | `player.gd` |
| AnimationPlayer playback (`play`, `seek`, `stop`, `pause`) | `player.gd` in the game; in a preview, its own preview script, and nothing else there. The supplemental timing probe `godot/tests/probe_a7_entry_order.gd` plays only its own instance of `player_visuals.tscn`, never the game's (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 1) |
| Original pose sprite: `texture`, `flip_h`, visibility | `player.gd` |
| Collision box (`set_box`) | `player.gd`, unchanged |
| `LowerPivot.position`, sprite offsets and regions | Nobody at runtime; the saved scene value |

The new visual layer only reads gameplay state (`pose`, `land_ticks`, `just_landed`, `tick`, `velocity`, `facing`); it never writes it. The existing pose assignment and collision updates in `_update_pose()` stay unchanged (player.gd lines 165–171).

## Godot 4 names

- Use Godot 4.7.2 names: `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationMixer`, `AnimationLibrary`, `Animation`, `Sprite2D` (`hframes`, `vframes`, `frame`, `region_enabled`, `region_rect`), `Node2D`.
- Loop: `Animation.loop_mode` with `Animation.LOOP_NONE` / `LOOP_LINEAR`, never a boolean `loop`. Speed: `speed_scale`, never `playback_speed`. Callback: `callback_mode_process` with `AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS`, never `playback_process_mode`.
- Update modes: `Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE` / `UPDATE_CONTINUOUS` via `value_track_set_update_mode()`. Frame sprites are `Sprite2D`; never `AnimatedSprite` (Godot 3), and `AnimatedSprite2D`/`SpriteFrames` are excluded by the brief (line 83).
- Checked against the Godot 4.7 class reference and probed with ClassDB on the installed 4.7.2 build (see Headless facts). If unsure a property, constant or method exists in 4.7.2, say so and check the 4.7 class reference or ClassDB before using it.

## Out of scope

- Gameplay: movement, input, jump buffer and coyote, collision boxes and layers, `choose_pose()` (its order, conditions and return values), `LAND_TICKS`, `SCOOT_FRAME` and every other value in `slice_tuning.gd` and `tuning.gd`.
- In `player.gd`, everything except the visual setup and the pose-to-visual mapping (brief line 102). `session.gd`, `fork.gd`, the HUD, sound and music, other level objects.
- The A5 shaders and materials, the A6 effects and driver, all source art and `.import` files other than the new sheet's, every existing test and its expected counts, and `scripts/run-test.sh`.
- Anything the brief does not name: no extra clips, AnimationTree, blend or state machine, bones or Skeleton2D, rotation, lag, overshoot, new gameplay windows, or keys on gameplay values.
